# Barima Automobile & Transportation Services

> Barima Automobile & Transportation Services buys any make and model of vehicle for customers in Canada and Ghana, ships vehicles to Ghana, and runs B-Drive, a private transportation service across Ontario, Canada. It is part of Barima Holdings.

## Vehicle sourcing

- We buy any make and model on a customer's behalf. We are registered with insurance auctions and also buy on the open market.
- Customers in Canada: we source the vehicle in Canada.
- Customers in Ghana: we buy the vehicle and ship it to Ghana. The customer pays import duty and clears the vehicle on arrival.
- Contact: +1 (416) 605-6280 (phone and WhatsApp), barimaautomobile.ca@gmail.com

## B-Drive (Ontario, Canada)

- Private pick-up and drop-off, airport transfers, hospital, emergency unit and railway station runs, corporate and personal trips, quick pickups and parcel deliveries across Ontario.
- Booking is by phone or WhatsApp: +1 (416) 605-6280, bdrive.ca@gmail.com

## Hours

- Sunday to Friday, 8am to 5pm Eastern Time. Closed Saturday.
